messages.subject: Donut holes with shiny-leaflet
parts:
Hello,
 I have been working on a shiny app that includes a Leaflet map. I have been using the shiny-leaflet package successfully, but I have encountered a problem with adding polygons. I can add the polygons correctly, but I cannot figure out how to remove "donut holes". For example, imagine you  have a land area, like a nation, with a large lake, and you want a polygon for the nation that removes the lake. 

Leaflet can do this - you normally pass it multiple arrays of coordinates - the first is the outer boundary of the polygon and the rest define the holes. Is there any way to do this with shiny-leaflet? If  I switch over to rCharts is it possible there?

JP

messages.author: ad1a6abcb84542f8
messages.subject: Re: Donut holes with shiny-leaflet
parts:
As far as I have tested, the shiny-leaflet library cannot handle donut holes or multipolygons (i may be wrong of course).

rCharts supports geoJson
 
 so it should be able to do it.
Here is the example in github
 (from Ramnath Vaidyanathan).

regards,

Franco
